# SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level 18 fourth-favored-terrain and
# fifth-combat-style-bonus-feat widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level-1..level-17
# hybrid chassis (tests/sd18_ranger_level17_hide_in_plain_sight.rs, the
# loop's most recent Ranger ceiling) to Ranger level 18 as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It is the level-17 fixture with the class level bumped
# and four additional chosen selections, exercising the 18th-level
# "4th favored terrain, combat style feat" row (verified independently
# against d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, both
# byte-for-byte identical):
#
#   choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_4:terrain:urban
#     -- the additional favored terrain selected at the 18th-level
#        interval, mirroring choice:ranger_favored_terrain_3's
#        open-ended recognition idiom
#   choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_bonus_increase_target_3:terrain:first
#     -- the 18th-level interval's OWN bonus-increase-target choice (each
#        interval grants its own +2 increase to any one favored terrain),
#        restricted to terrain:first | terrain:second | terrain:third |
#        terrain:fourth; this fixture names the first favored terrain
#        again, STACKING with the 8th- and 13th-level intervals' own
#        increases (2 base + 2 + 2 + 2 = +8 on the first favored terrain)
#   choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_5:feat:improved_precise_shot
#     -- the FIFTH combat-style bonus feat, granted at 18th ranger level.
#        Mirroring the 14th-level fourth bonus feat's own reasoning: the
#        PF1 Core Rulebook's own Ranger Combat Styles tables (Archery and
#        Two-Weapon Combat) do not tabulate any NEW named feat options
#        beyond the 10th-level tier (verified independently against three
#        primary sources dedicated to the combat-style feat lists
#        specifically: d20pfsrd's Ranger Combat Styles page, the Archives
#        of Nethys aonprd.com RangerCombatStyles page, and a Paizo
#        rules-forum thread on the same question -- all three agree the
#        printed Core Rulebook list stops naming new options after 10th
#        level; only later sourcebooks such as the Advanced Player's
#        Guide add named 18th-level options, out of SD-18's
#        Core-Rulebook-only scope). This fixture therefore names a feat
#        already legal at an earlier tier (Improved Precise Shot, from
#        the 6th-level Archery list) purely as a raw chosen-input string
#        exercising the OPEN-ENDED recognition idiom (mirroring the
#        Favored Terrain/Quarry choice-recognition idiom, not the
#        closed-restricted-list idiom used for feats 1-3): the seam
#        records only that a fifth combat-style bonus feat slot was
#        chosen, with no restricted-list validation attempted at this
#        tier and no mechanical value fabricated.
#
# Everything else carries over from the level-17 fixture unchanged. No
# terrain-detection engine exists in this codebase, so no favored
# terrain's bonus is ever applied to an Initiative or skill total; the
# fixture makes no such claim.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level18-sd18-fourth-favored-terrain-and-fifth-combat-style-feat
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:18
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_2:enemy:undead
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target:enemy:first
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_4:enemy:construct
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target_3:enemy:fourth
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_2:feat:manyshot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_3:feat:shot_on_the_run
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_4:feat:improved_precise_shot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_5:feat:improved_precise_shot
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain:terrain:forest
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_2:terrain:mountain
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_bonus_increase_target:terrain:first
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_3:terrain:swamp
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_bonus_increase_target_2:terrain:first
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_4:terrain:urban
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_bonus_increase_target_3:terrain:first
choice=choice:ranger_hunters_bond:form:bond
choice=choice:ranger_quarry_target:enemy:humanoid_orc
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
